notes.title: It's time to talk.
notes.notes:
[b] Dear players. [/ b]
Today our studio Shagapov Production (HeartDreamers) informs you that the Resonance project is frozen indefinitely. Why did it happen? Our company decided to move in a different direction - 3D games, soon you will see the full game - not an alpha version. During this time, eleven thousand people played the game, which could fill the whole 1/3 of the Olympic stadium. We are very glad that you showed interest in the game and we apologize for not being able to please you with the updates. There are several reasons for this.
[i] [u] 1) S.C.P. Development Team The resonance fell apart.
2) The interest of the head of the project was exhausted, to some extent.
3) Studio Shagapov Productions, began to focus on a wider market. [/ U] [/ i]
Shagapov Productions studio plans to release SOS PROJECT game in the future - this is our codename. Development has already begun, but so far it is only at the script level, but all concepts and documents are ready.
[i] Thank you for your understanding. [/ i]
[b] Head of the project - Emil Shagapov. [/ b]

notes.title: Recycling, Remake, Remaster?
notes.notes:
"- On his face was read not only anger, but also sadness. Something is happening to him. I do not know what, but I would like to help him in any way I can, even if it costs me my life."
We are working on reworking the game.
The processing includes:
1. Drawn sprites, not 3D models.
2. Change the game engine.
3. Change the story and concept of the game.
4. Change the name of the game.
5. Switch to the Buy to play system with the announcement of the first alpha. So while it's available for free, take it.
